name: creditkarma-mcp
description: Credit Karma transaction tracking for Claude — sync and query your transactions, spending by category and merchant, and account summaries via natural language

ck_cookies.title: Credit Karma Cookie Header
ck_cookies.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback (https://github.com/nullnet-app/contextmint-bridge/releases) — sign into creditkarma.com in the browser and the MCP will read the cookies automatically. Otherwise paste the full Cookie header from a signed-in creditkarma.com request (DevTools → Network → any creditkarma.com request → Request Headers).

ck_db_path.title: Database File Path
ck_db_path.description: Optional override for the SQLite database file. Defaults to ~/.creditkarma-mcp/transactions.db. Set to a custom absolute path if you want the data stored elsewhere.

ck_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable Browser Fallback (advanced)
ck_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy fallback (headless / CI). Missing credentials then become a hard error.

ck_session_path.title: Saved Session File Path
ck_session_path.description: Optional override for the saved-session file that ck_set_session and token refreshes write. Defaults to ~/.creditkarma-mcp/session.

ck_credit_bureau.title: Credit Bureau
ck_credit_bureau.description: Credit report used for card and loan balances: transunion or equifax. Defaults to transunion.

ck_sync_max_pages.title: Sync Page Budget (advanced)
ck_sync_max_pages.description: Pages one ck_sync_transactions call may fetch before pausing. Unset (or unparseable) = unbounded, which is what a local stdio server wants. Set it on a hosted deployment, where the call has to answer inside the client's request timeout.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

tools.name: ck_healthcheck
tools.description: Resolve the credential the way real tools do, then make one authenticated request to creditkarma.com; reports the credential source, whether it was accepted, and which hop broke. Read-only; never returns the credential

tools.name: ck_set_session
tools.description: Store a Credit Karma session cookie to enable automatic token refresh

tools.name: ck_forget_session
tools.description: Delete the saved Credit Karma session file and clear in-memory credentials (local only)

tools.name: ck_sync_transactions
tools.description: Sync Credit Karma transactions into the local SQLite database, then refresh account balances

tools.name: ck_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions with optional filters. Paginated.

tools.name: ck_get_recent_transactions
tools.description: Return the N most recent transactions

tools.name: ck_get_spending_by_category
tools.description: Group debit transactions by category and return totals

tools.name: ck_get_spending_by_merchant
tools.description: Return top merchants by total debit spend

tools.name: ck_get_account_summary
tools.description: Return per-account debit, credit, and net totals

tools.name: ck_get_account_balances
tools.description: Current balance of every account — linked bank, card, loan and investment accounts live, plus credit-report cards and loans — with credit limit, available credit, as-of time and a stale flag; refresh:true fetches live first

tools.name: ck_query_sql
tools.description: Execute a raw SQL SELECT query against the transactions database (capped at max_rows, default 500)
